newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson to outsource circuit board production.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson to outsource circuit board production.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Tuesday it would outsource its printed circuit board manufacturing outside Sweden and that restructuring would affect 1,400 employees.
The move stems from Ericsson's decision to team up with two leading contract electronic manufacturers, U.S. based SCI Systems, Inc and Solectron Corp , Ericsson said in a statement.
Ericsson's business area Infocom Systems signed memoranda of understanding with the companies, with final agreements expected within two months.

Within two years, the contract producers will gradually take over a large part of the global printed board assembly related to the AXE switch and certain access products, moving production to their plants abroad, Ericsson said.
"The business environment in the telecommunications supply industry is characterised by increased competition," business area head Anders Igel said in a statement.
"We foresee increased volumes but technological development necessitates a concentration of our production capacity."
